item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 2:51 AM, 25 November 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (Santo Tomas, Malvar, Tanauan, Lipa, Talisay, Mataasnakahoy, and Balete), Cavite (Bacoor, Imus, Kawit, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Carmona, Silang, Tagaytay, Noveleta, Cavite City, General Trias, Rosario, Amadeo, Tanza, and Trece Martires), Laguna (Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, and Victoria), Metro Manila (Pasig, Makati, Taguig, Muntinlupa, Las Pinas, Paranaque, Mandaluyong, Pateros, Manila, Pasay, and Marikina), Quezon (Infanta, General Nakar, Tagkawayan, Calauag, Guinayangan, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Polillo, Jomalig, Patnanungan, Lucban, Tiaong, and San Antonio), and Rizal (Antipolo, Cainta, and San Mateo) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Laguna (Mabitac, Santa Maria, Pakil, Siniloan, Famy, Pangil, Paete, Kalayaan, Lumban, Cavinti, Santa Cruz, Pagsanjan, Luisiana, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Cabuyao, Calamba, and Los Banos), Quezon (Mauban, Real, and Sampaloc), and Rizal (Jala-Jala, Pililla, Cardona, Binangonan, Morong, Tanay, Baras, Angono, Taytay, and Teresa) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
